name: High-Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Add all the ingredients to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. If you prefer a thinner consistency, add a splash of extra almond milk. Squeeze in some lemon juice for a little extra zing and pour it out into a bowl.
Finish with your toppings. We've gone for some fruit, granola, peanut butter, a drizzle of honey and more chia seeds for extra crunch. But add whatever you fancy.
